title: Acids, Salts and Metals in Depth
summary: Grade 10: important salts and water of crystallisation, titration, ionic bonding, and how metals are extracted and refined.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Understanding how ions combine and how metals are extracted helps industry make useful materials while managing energy and environmental costs.

factual: How is plaster of Paris made?
conceptual: Why do ionic compounds conduct only when molten or dissolved?
How does reactivity decide the extraction method?
debatable: Should metals be recycled by law, given the energy used to extract them?
